newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Jelmoli to simplify capital structure.
newsitem.headline: Jelmoli to simplify capital structure.

text.p: Share warrants issued by OZ Holding should help simplify the share structure of Swiss retail group Jelmoli Holding AG and increase the number of shares in free float, Jelmoli executives said.

Jelmoli chief executive Peter Leumann said in response to inquiries that the full exercise of these warrants would eliminate a B-type class of bearer share that was created when Swiss businessman Walter Fust acquired a majority of the company.
Earlier on Thursday OZ Holding, a unit of Martin Ebner's BZ Group Holding, issued and placed call warrants on 200,000 Jelmoli bearer and 200,000 registered shares.
The underlying bearer shares are mainly owned by Walter Fust, who in November 1996 raised his share of Jelmoli's capital to 51.9 percent.
Jelmoli said Fust plans to cover a portion of the warrants with 125,000 bearer shares he owns or has options to acquire.
Jelmoli itself would cover 25,000 shares from its own stock holdings and third parties would deliver another 50,000.
All of the underlying 200,000 registered shares are held by Jelmoli, with 145,000 shares, and third parties with the remaining 55,000.

Initially, however, Fust and Jelmoli will purchase 50 percent of the warrants -- equal to their ownership of shares -- in order to profit from any possible rise in the share price above the warrants' exercise price, Jelmoli said in a statement.
Leumann said the transaction would allow the shares to be gradually placed in the market and simultanously Fust and Jelmoli could realise a maximum gain.

The statement also said the issuance of options should give Jelmoli a premium income of around 2.8 million Swiss francs and this should lead to a corresponding rise in the company's 1997 financial income.

If the call options were to be exercised in 1998, Jelmoli should realise a book profit of around 27.5 million francs, based on an original price of 700 francs for the bearer shares and 150 francs for the registered shares.
